groups.sentence: Instructors and staff share academic integrity policies with students and align with instructor guidance on AI.
Students read each course syllabus and assignment instructions to learn what AI use is allowed.
Students are responsible for understanding and following the AI expectations of each course.
Students ask or consult their instructors to clarify AI expectations when they are unsure.
AI rules and expectations differ between courses and instructors.
Students follow the AI rules their instructor sets for the course.
Students check the assignment-specific instructions on AI use, in addition to the syllabus.
Students do not use AI when the instructor prohibits it or beyond the limits the instructor sets.
Not knowing or not clarifying the rules is not an excuse for a violation.
Students understand and follow the university, school, program and departmental AI guidelines.
Students are responsible for using AI ethically and for knowing what is permitted.
Everyone follows the AI guidelines set by their institution, dean, instructor or supervisor.
